  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JUNE 13, 2023

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Davis at 5:32 p.m., on
  Tuesday, June 13, 2023, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Gleam Davis
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Christine Parra
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis (arrived at 5:47 p.m.)
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick (arrived at 5:34 p.m.)

  Absent:  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:32 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers Zwick, Torosis, and de la
  Torre. Councilmember Parra led the assemblage in the Pledge of
  Allegiance.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 6:53 p.m., to consider
  Councilmember Zwick  closed sessions and returned at 7:47 p.m., with all members present, except
  arrived at 5:34 p.m.  Councilmember de la Torre, to report the following:

  Councilmember Torosis  3.A. Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation – Gov. Code
  arrived at 5:47 p.m.  Section 54956.9(d)(1): Black Lives Matter, et al. v. City of Santa
  Monica, et al.; United States District Court, Central District of
  California Case No. 21-cv-05253; Catrice Clemons v. City of Santa
  Monica, et al.; LASC Case No.: 21STCV23577; Alejandra Garcia,
  et al. v. City of Santa Monica, et al.; LASC Case No.:
  21STCV07940; Cheyanne Robinson, et al. v. City of Santa Monica,
  et al., Case No. 21STCV22392;Paula Rosado v. City of Santa
  Monica, et al.; LASC Case No. 22STCV19789; Sean Singletary v.
  City of Santa Monica, et al.; United States District Court, Central
  District of California Case No. Case No.: 22-cv-01606.

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action

  1  June 13, 2023

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 7:48 p.m.
